description.value:
You project an emoji of your deity's religious symbol around yourself. When you Cast the Spell and the first time you Sustain it on each subsequent turn, choose one of the following benefits depending on the emoji used.

  • Prayer of Grace You gain a +20-foot status bonus to your Speeds until the start of your next turn.

  • Prayer of Healing You regain 4 Hit Points at the start of your next turn.

  • Prayer of Protection You gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws until the start of your next turn.

  • Prayer of Retribution Until the start of your next turn, creatures that hit you with melee Strikes take 4 spirit damage.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Prayermoji]

Heightened (+1) The Hit Points regained increase by 1, and the spirit damage increases by 1.
